question: Does the actual P1/P2 seam determine a common field, state and time map with the quarter phase retained, and what exact operator conditions permit reconstruction?
summary_de: Im gegebenen skalaren CAR-Quellenmodell folgt die gemeinsame Feld-, Zustands- und Zeitwirkung bei erhaltener Viertelphase. Die erzeugte Energie E=alpha+Var(phi′)/2 waehlt unter allen H1-Windung-eins-Symbolen eindeutig die gleichmaessige Windung, bis auf Gesamtphase. Keine passend geaenderte Zeit und kein endlicher Suchbeweis. Die Auswahl dieser Quelle und der Minimum-Energie-Regel aus P1/P2 ist noch nicht hergeleitet. Der Originalbeweis minimaler Defekte klassifiziert seine minimale Operatorfaser nicht.
summary_en: In the given scalar CAR source, the joint field, state and time action retains the quarter phase. The excitation energy E=alpha+Var(phi prime)/2 uniquely minimizes at the uniform winding among all H1 winding-one symbols, modulo phase, without changing the time generator. This is an analytic result, not a finite search proof. Selection of this source and the minimum-energy rule from P1/P2 is not derived. The original minimal-defect argument does not classify its minimal operator fiber.
scope: Original-source proof audit; abstract operator reconstruction under stated isometry, purity, minimal dilation and actual-time hypotheses; complete continuous scalar Hardy-symbol classification, exact rational diagnostics and conditional CAR sea transport. Same-source CAR excitation-energy identity and global minimizer in the H1 scalar-multiplier class; not uniqueness in the full restricted unitary group.
assumptions: For the abstract reconstruction: actual projection C, unitary U, zero leakage, Fredholm index -1, purity and minimal unitary dilation.
Actual selfadjoint B on a common invariant core obeys U*BU=B+1 with wandering eigenvalue alpha=1/4 or 3/4.
For field/state conclusions: the actual algebra is charged CAR and the physical state is the pure quasifree negative sea.
The executable symbol diagnosis assumes the scalar Hardy realization; it does not derive this realization from P1/P2.

For energy comparison: fixed scalar B_alpha=N+alpha, fixed CAR sea representation and reference state, unimodular H1 multiplication candidates. No zero-leakage assumption. Derivation of the rule that P1 selects the least excited charge-one state is outstanding.
positive_results: Exact compression identity C-S*S=CU*(1-C)UC and algebraic Lean certificate.
All continuous scalar unimodular Hardy symbols of winding one that compress isometrically are single Blaschke factors; this is an analytic classification, not finite enumeration.
Conditional abstract reconstruction of modes and B=N+alpha from the same operator pair and actual-time covariance.
Conditional CAR field action and exact R*QR=Q+1, R*H_alpha R=H_alpha+Q+alpha with quarter transition retained.
Original-source audit identifies the unsupported step from minimal integer defect value to unique operator tuple.

For every unimodular H1 scalar symbol of winding one, E=alpha+mean((phi prime-1)^2)/2. Unique minimizer u=phase*z in this class. Blaschke b_(1/4) and non-inner z^2/b_(1/4) both have exact excess 1/15.

Source audit of 02_carrier_source.tex:3020-3063: the stratified master functional fixes the unique discrete datum and sets a zero/infinity barrier using B_min. It does not independently select B_min or derive the charge-one least-excitation rule; its electromagnetic alpha is not the quarter-domain parameter.
not_derived: On the Wold route only: the actual P1/P2 operator pair has zero leakage, purity and minimal generation. Nonzero leakage is not physical exclusion.
The original time, CAR field algebra, quasifree state, P2 carrier and E8 extension are identified with the reconstructed objects.
The actual P1 seam obeys the minimum-energy selection rule in the original CAR source; scalar uniqueness does not establish full operator-source uniqueness.
Physical event law or complete T1-T8 solution.
